module purpose: neorv32_twi is a bus-attached two-wire serial controller: a bus write with addr(2)='0' sets enable, prescaler select, clock divider and clock-stretch enable (lines 133-139); a write with addr(2)='1' queues an 11-bit command in a TX FIFO sub-unit (lines 197-198); an engine pops each command, drives SCL and SDA through a state machine timed by a divided tick and a four-phase sequence, shifts a 9-bit word out on SDA and in from the sampled SDA, writes received words to an RX FIFO sub-unit that bus reads return, reports line, FIFO and busy status on reads, exports the enable on clkgen_en_o and raises irq_o when enabled, idle and the TX FIFO is empty.

use-case flows.value: control settings (enable, prescaler select, clock divider, clock-stretch enable) taken from bus write data on a write with addr(2)='0'
11-bit command (data byte, ACK control bit, two operation bits) pushed into the TX FIFO on a bus write with addr(2)='1'
next command popped from the TX FIFO and loaded into the engine (byte and ACK bit into engine.sreg, operation bits into engine.state) when the engine is idle, a command is pending and a tick occurs
tick: one pulse each time the counter reaches ctrl.cdiv, counting on the prescaler enable selected by ctrl.prsc, while enabled
four-phase bit timing: one-hot phase register rotated on each tick unless the clock-stretch hold is active, decoded into one-cycle phase pulses
engine operation: the selected operation drives SCL and SDA levels per phase, shifts the data word out and the sampled SDA in, counts nine bits and signals completion
line sampling: twi_sda_i and twi_scl_i converted and passed through two-stage synchronizers
irq_o raised when enabled, TX FIFO empty and engine not busy; enable exported on clkgen_en_o; line levels, TX full, RX available and busy returned on a control read
received word (byte with ACK bit) written to the RX FIFO on completion and returned on a bus read with addr(2)='1', which pops the FIFO; control settings returned on a read with addr(2)='0'
registers forced to constants while rstn_i is '0'; tick, counter, phase register and both FIFOs cleared while ctrl.enable is '0'
